item_short_desc: Ensure safety during nighttime workouts with Rothco’s Reflective Physical Training Belt. Constructed with hi-visibility reflective material and a durable polyester lining, this belt enhances visibility in low-light conditions, keeping you safe during evening runs or exercises. Originally designed for active-duty personel, this belt is ideal for joggers and anyone who exercises after dark. The fully adjustable design features a slide adjustment buckle and secure closure, accommodating waist sizes up to 45 inches.
